description: List the caller's active watches, bounded at 20. Requires an agent key or account token with record:read; get a key: POST https://interfacedelta.com/api/v1/agent-keys. 1–50 tools; default lifetime 30 days, maximum 90 days; at most 20 active watches and 50 creations per principal per UTC day; creation costs one Record API request per tool; polling, listing and stopping consume none; polling at most once per 60 seconds per principal and watchId, default page 20, maximum 50, replay ceiling 30 days, nextPollMs 900000.
name: list_watches
title: List watches
